title: [review] 03-adaptation.md: Incorrect compressed size for RPL rules
description: The claimed 19-byte compressed size does not account for RPL base fields. Per the Python implementation (rules.py lines 576-617), DODAGID alone is 128 bits (16 bytes) value-sent, plus instance, kd_flags/dtsn/gmop/rank, and seq fields. The actual compressed size should be approximately 36+ bytes for DAO and larger for DIO.
close_reason: Fixed: Corrected compressed size claim from '19 bytes' to 'DIO 40 bytes, DAO 37 bytes'. The original figure omitted the DODAGID (16 bytes) and DIO-specific fields (version, rank, gmop, dtsn). Also removed misleading 'ports' reference since these are ICMPv6 messages.
